chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
O people, indeed the glance is from Satan. So whoever finds something of that, let him go to his family.

key_terms.أَهْلَهُ: his family, here meaning his wife or lawful spouse
key_terms.الشَّيْطَانِ: Satan, the source of wrongful temptation
key_terms.النَّظْرَةُ: the glance, especially a look that stirs desire

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith teach about dealing with lustful glances?
ai.summary: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله teaches that a wrongful or desire-stirring glance has a satanic source and should not be indulged. The hadith directs a person to respond lawfully by turning to one’s spouse rather than following temptation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4975 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"O' people, indeed the (lustful) glance is from Satan. So whoever experiences something from that, let him go to his family."
